name: Felsőszölnök (Hungary)
description: A vertical banner of two stripes, red at the hoist and light grey at the fly, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Felsőszölnök: a red shield with a white figure of a saint on a green mound.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
